mapper.select: select HISTORY_ID, PRODUCT_ID, TRADE_TYPE, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, FINAL_PRICE, to_char(COMPLETED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "CREATED_AT_STR" from TRANSACTION_HISTORY where BUYER_NO = #{userNo} or SELLER_NO = #{userNo} order by COMPLETED_AT desc
mapper.insert: insert into TRANSACTION_HISTORY (PRODUCT_ID, TRADE_TYPE, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, FINAL_PRICE) values (#{productId}, #{tradeType}, #{sellerNo}, #{buyerNo}, #{finalPrice})
